name: @supersdk/jssdk
description: Environment-neutral SuperSDK runtime for Web and Hybrid applications

scripts.test:bridge: npm run check:bridge-generated && node --test tests/bridge-*.test.mjs tests/runtime-compat.test.mjs
scripts.test:monitoring: npm run check:monitoring-generated && node --test --test-timeout=120000 tests/monitoring-lifecycle.test.mjs tests/monitoring-consent.test.mjs tests/monitoring-errors.test.mjs tests/monitoring-performance.test.mjs tests/monitoring-jsb.test.mjs tests/monitoring-budget.test.mjs tests/monitoring-budget.performance.test.mjs tests/monitoring-public-contract.test.mjs tests/monitoring-public-entry.test.mjs tests/monitoring-compat.test.mjs tests/monitoring-remote-adapter.test.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:bridge && npm run test:monitoring && npm run check:suenc-generated && node --test --test-timeout=120000 tests/suenc.test.mjs tests/analytics-flush.test.mjs tests/api-environment.test.mjs tests/analytics-params.test.mjs tests/analytics-persistence.test.mjs tests/analytics-queue.test.mjs tests/consent-migration.test.mjs tests/runtime.test.mjs tests/settings-cache.test.mjs tests/settings-contract.test.mjs tests/settings-errors.test.mjs tests/settings-security.test.mjs tests/feedback.test.mjs tests/push.test.mjs tests/experiment.test.mjs && node supersdk.test.cjs
scripts.test:browser: npm run build && node --test --test-timeout=300000 tests/browser.e2e.test.mjs tests/monitoring-browser.e2e.test.mjs
scripts.test:pack: npm run build && node --test --test-timeout=300000 tests/public-entry-smoke.test.mjs tests/public-export-gate.test.mjs tests/public-pack-clean-install.test.mjs tests/monitoring-public-pack.test.mjs tests/release-provenance.e2e.test.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run verify:public-tree && npm run test && npm run test:browser && npm run test:pack && npm run test:public && npm run verify:public-tree
